item.title: GovAI UK Summer Fellowship 2027 (Fully Funded)
item.dc:creator: Fawad Afridi
item.content:encoded:
Do you want to work in London and learn about artificial intelligence (AI)? The GovAI UK Summer Fellowship 2027 offers a three-month program with a £14,000 salary and travel support. The fully funded fellowship will take place from June 7 to August 27, 2027. People from different countries and work backgrounds can apply.

GovAI runs this program to help people learn about AI rules and policies. The fellowship has two tracks: Research and Applied. Selected fellows will work on projects, attend workshops, and learn from experts.

Fellows will work at the GovAI office in London. They will receive a salary, travel support, and free lunch on weekdays. GovAI also offers temporary work visa sponsorship for those who need it. The last date to apply is November 22, 2026.

Quick Overview of GovAI UK Summer Fellowship 2027:

  • Host Country: United Kingdom
  • Location: London
  • Host Organization: GovAI (Governance AI)
  • Program Name: UK Summer Fellowship 2027

Application Deadline:

  • November 22, 2026
